user_fields.description: These fields are returned, unmodified, in the user_fields section of the response.

PostalCode.description: The postal code for the address.

USUrbanName.description: U.S. address urbanization name. Used primarily for Puerto Rico addresses.

OutputAddressBlocks.description: Specifies whether to return a formatted version of the address.

PerformUSProcessing.description: Specifies whether or not to process U.S. addresses.

PerformDPV.description: Delivery Point Validation (DPV�) validates that a specific address exists

OutputFormattedOnFail.description: Specifies whether to return a formatted address when an address cannot be validated.

OutputPostalCodeSeparator.description: Specifies whether to use separators (spaces or hyphens) in ZIP" Codes or Canadian postal codes.

OutputCountryFormat.description: Specifies the format to use for the country name returned in the Country output field.

KeepMultimatch.description: Indicates whether to return multiple address for input addresses that have more than one possible matches.

OutputCasing.description: Specifies the casing of the output address. M for mixed case and U for upper case.

MaximumResults.description: Specifies a number between 1 and 10 that indicates the maximum number of addresses to be returned.

OutputRecordType.description: Specifies the type of the output record.

OutputFieldLevelReturnCodes.description: Identifies which output addresses are candidate addresses as value if Y for OutputFieldLevelReturnCodes.

DPVDetermineNoStat.description: Determines the no stat status of an address which means it exists but cannot receive mails.

StreetMatchingStrictness.description: Specifies the algorithm to determe if an input address matches in the postal database.

CanFrenchApartmentLabel.description: Specifies the default apartment label for the output if there is no apartment label in the input address. This is specific to French address.

OutputAbbreviatedAlias.description: Specifies whether to use a street's abbreviated alias in the output if the output address line is longer than 31 characters.

DPVSuccessfulStatusCondition.description: Selecting the match condition where a DPV result does NOT cause a record to fail.

StandardAddressPMBLine.description: Specifies where Private Mailbox (PMB) information is placed.

FirmMatchingStrictness.description: Specifies the algorithm to determining if an input address matches in the postal database.

CanRuralRouteFormat.description: Specifies where to place rural route delivery information.

CanPreferHouseNum.description: Specifies whether to select a house number of postal code in case of conflict.

OutputPreferredAlias.description: Specifies whether to use a street's preferred alias in the output.

DirectionalMatchingStrictness.description: Specifies the algorithm to determine if an input address matches in the postal database.

ExtractFirm.description: Specifies whether to extract the firm name from AddressLine1 through AddressLine4 and place it in the FirmName output field.

FailOnCMRAMatch.description: Specifies whether to consider Treat Commercial Mail Receiving Agency (CMRA) matches as failures?

CanNonCivicFormat.description: Specifies whether or not non-civic keywords are abbreviated in the output.

CanSSLVRFlg.description: Changes the civic and/or suite information to match the LVR or single-single record.

OutputStreetNameAlias.description: Specifies how to handle street name aliases used in the input. This is specific to US.

PerformEWS.description: Specifies the Early Warning System (EWS) that uses the USPS EWS File to validate addresses that are not in the ZIP + 4 database.

CanOutputCityFormat.description: Specifies whether to use the long, medium, or short version of the city if the city has a long name.

DualAddressLogic.description: Specifies how to return a match if multiple non-blank address lines are present or multiple address types are on the same address line. (U.S. addresses only.)

PerformSuiteLink.description: Specifies whether to perform SuiteLink processing.

CanStandardAddressFormat.description: Specifies where to place secondary address information in the output address.

OutputPreferredCity.description: Specifies whether the preferred last line city name should be stored.

OutputMultinationalCharacters.description: Specifies whether to return multinational characters, including diacritical marks such as umlauts or accents.

CanDeliveryOfficeFormat.description: Specifies where to place station information.

PerformLACSLink.description: Facilitates the conversion of rural route address converting into street-style address using the LACS.

CanDualAddressLogic.description: Specifies whether ValidateMailingAddressUSCAN should return a street match or a PO Box/non-civic match when the address contains both civic and non-civic information.

ExtractUrb.description: Specifies whether to extract the urbanization name from AddressLine1 through AddressLine4 and place it in the USUrbanName output field.

StandardAddressFormat.description: Specifies where to place secondary address information for U.S. addresses.

CanFrenchFormat.description: Specifies how to determine the language (English or French) to use to format the address and directional.

DPVDetermineVacancy.description: Determines if the location has been unoccupied for at least 90 days.

CanEnglishApartmentLabel.description: Specifies the default apartment label to use in the output if there is no apartment label in the input address. rhis is specific to English addresses.

SuppressZplusPhantomCarrierR777.description: Specifies whether to supress addresses with Carrier Route R777.

CanOutputCityAlias.description: Specifies whether or not to return the city alias when the alias is in the input address.

OutputShortCityName.description: Specifies how to format city names that have short city name or non-mailing city name alternatives.
